item.title: AI-SPM Explained: How to Secure AI Agents
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: January 20, 2026
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence Security", "Enterprise Technology", "Cybersecurity", "AI Governance", "Risk Management"]
Summary:
  • Generative AI and autonomous agents transform enterprise operations.
  • They introduce new security challenges beyond traditional frameworks.
  • AI systems are dynamic and can be manipulated via prompt injection.
  • AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) is a proactive, holistic security approach.
  • AI-SPM covers data, model, application, and runtime layers.
  • It ensures AI safety, trustworthiness, and regulatory compliance.
